title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 CMPCT
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 v2 ‘Slate Carbon’ dresses the casual sneaker in a patterned Primeknit upper in neutral shades of black, grey, and tan. The slip-on build is secured with no-tie rope laces and a sock-like cuff, which offers lightweight support with a full range of motion. Yeezy branding is limited to the sockliner. Responsive cushioning is provided by a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a TPU cage and exposed through cut-outs in the rubber outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 ‘Hi-Res Red’ delivers an especially vibrant colorway of Kanye West’s maximalist lifestyle runner. A bold crimson finish dominates the top portion of the upper, featuring a mesh base with tonal leather and suede construction on the eyestay and heel. Contrasting hits of black and grey land on reinforced suede overlays, along with burgundy mesh on the toe box. Responsive cushioning is provided by a full-length Boost midsole, encapsulated within a maroon-colored PU carrier with orange and green accents.
